name: Read Company Infobox from Wikipedia
description: Searches Wikipedia for a given company name using the search box, clicks the top matching suggestion to open its article, and extracts the company's ISIN, industry, and headquarters from the infobox. Use this when you need quick, structured company facts sourced from Wikipedia's infobox.

inputs.name: companyName
inputs.description: The name of the company to search for on Wikipedia; typed into the search box to trigger the suggestion dropdown.

outputs.name: isin
outputs.description: The company's International Securities Identification Number (ISIN) as listed in the Wikipedia infobox.

outputs.name: industry
outputs.description: The industry classification of the company as listed in the Wikipedia infobox.

outputs.name: headquarters
outputs.description: The headquarters location(s) of the company as listed in the Wikipedia infobox.

steps.rationale: This is the search input on the Wikipedia main page (labelled "Search Wikipedia"). I need to type the company name here to search.
Typing into the focused Wikipedia search box to invoke the suggestion dropdown for "Bank of America".

target.name: Bank of America American multinational banking and financial services corporation

steps.rationale: This is the top search suggestion matching the exact company name "Bank of America" (described as the American multinational banking corporation). Clicking it opens the Bank of America article.

checkpoint.description: Searched Wikipedia for "Bank of America", clicked the matching top suggestion, and opened the article at en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bank_of_America. From the company infobox I extracted: ISIN = US0605051046; Industry = Financial services; Headquarters = Bank of America Corporate Center, Charlotte, North Carolina, U.S. (corporate/legal) / Bank of America Tower (Manhattan), New York City, U.S. (executive).
